opening.argument: The speaker presents BitConnect lending as a route to daily interest generated by a purported Bitcoin trading bot, directing viewers to send bitcoin to a wallet and lend it to BitConnect. The offer begins with a stated $100 minimum and a description link for sign-up, while the description adds a spreadsheet for compounding interest through the speaker’s referral link. On-screen materials display lending amounts, accrued-daily-interest terms, and capital-release periods tied to volatility software and a trading bot. Although the speaker calls the projections approximate, joining a team is presented as a way to double or triple the result. These features establish a solicitation built around projected trading-bot or funded-contract returns, without proving that displayed figures were withdrawable profit.
